en.title: GTA 6 Pre-Sales Shatter Expectations, Take-Two CEO Reveals
en.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI's pre-order numbers are "far in excess of our expectations," according to Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick. The monumental anticipation for Rockstar Games' next blockbuster is already translating into unprecedented financial metrics ahead of its November 19, 2026 launch.
en.body:
The wait for **Grand Theft Auto VI** is almost over, and the initial financial indicators suggest it's going to be an all-time record-breaker. Take-Two Interactive CEO **Strauss Zelnick** has confirmed that pre-sales for Rockstar Games' highly anticipated title are "running far in excess of our expectations." This statement, made during the company's Q2 2027 earnings call, signals a level of demand that has even surpassed the publisher's ambitious projections.


**Zelnick** was careful to temper the excitement with his usual business prudence, noting that "we never claim success before it occurs." However, the overwhelming response to **GTA 6** in its pre-order phase is undeniable. With the game set to launch globally on November 19, 2026, and pre-loads beginning just ten days prior on November 10, players are clearly eager to dive back into the sprawling world of Vice City and beyond. Take-Two has committed to sharing more performance details post-launch, which will be crucial for investors and fans alike to gauge the game's full impact.

## A New Benchmark for Blockbusters

While specific figures for pre-order numbers and revenue have not been officially disclosed, the sentiment from **Zelnick** paints a clear picture of massive commercial success already underway. Industry observers have speculated wildly about the game's budget, with some reports suggesting it could exceed $2 billion, making it one of the most expensive entertainment projects ever undertaken. This immense investment is expected to yield a game of unparalleled scope, reportedly featuring a map triple the size of **Red Dead Redemption 2** and developed by a team that has doubled in size since that title's release. The standard edition of **GTA 6** is priced at $80, with a $100 Ultimate Edition offering additional in-game benefits.

## The Unstoppable Force of Grand Theft Auto

For fans, this news is less about the financial implications and more about the confirmation of the immense quality and anticipation surrounding **GTA 6**. The franchise has a storied history of pushing boundaries in open-world design, storytelling, and sheer player freedom. The prolonged development cycle and the scarcity of official information have only amplified the community's desire to experience what Rockstar Games has crafted this time. The sheer volume of pre-sales suggests that **GTA 6** is poised to dominate conversations and player engagement for years to come, appealing to both the long-time veterans who grew up with the series and a new generation of gamers discovering its unique brand of satire and sandbox mayhem.

## What's Next

The global launch of **Grand Theft Auto VI** is scheduled for November 19, 2026. Players can begin pre-loading the game on November 10, 2026. Further post-launch performance details will be shared by Take-Two Interactive in the coming months.

content_raw: Grand Theft Auto 6 is about nine days away from launch, and it almost doesn’t feel real. That notion could also apply to its pre-sales, with Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick telling Variety that they’re “running far in excess of our expectations. “That’s a good thing.” However, he reiterated the same belief that he’s said several times before. “We never claim success before it occurs. So we’re just days away from beginning to see the fruits of our labor.” Players (and shareholders) won’t have to wait long to learn about it either, as the publisher will “certainly be giving more information about how GTA 6 performs post-launch.” Whether that’s on the same day or with its next financial results remains to be seen, but it’s expected to do big business. The latest estimates from Sensor Tower claim that 7.71 million copies have been sold , allegedly generating $751 million in revenue. About 74 percent of sales are allegedly on PS5, which is good news for Sony given its partnership with Rockstar Games. Neither the developer nor Take-Two has confirmed the budget, especially after UK public records claimed it was over $2 billion . However, with a map triple the size of Red Dead Redemption 2 and a team that’s doubled since the latter’s release , it should certainly rank among the most expensive titles of all time. Grand Theft Auto 6 retails for $80, with the $100 Ultimate Edition providing exclusive access to multiple stores and other benefits.
